critical_code_review_comments: coupons.tsx bizRow: `bizName` uses `maxWidth: '55%'` alongside `numberOfLines={1}`, so a long merchant name gets ellipsised (currently visible as 'Karak Cafe Dubai (QA De…' in the /coupons list). Fine on desktop-width mobile viewport but on the home rail (68px discount tile + info column ~250px) the truncation kicks in early. Consider bumping to `flex: 1, minWidth: 0` if merchant names get longer in production seed.
home.tsx: the NEARBY DEALS rail is only rendered when `deals.length > 0` — good defensive check; also the See all link is only visible if the rail is shown, which is consistent with UX intent.

SafeImage.tsx: the `isPlaceholder` heuristic keys off `ui-avatars.com` substring only. If backend adds other placeholder providers (e.g. dicebear, avatars.dicebear.com) the same purple/off-brand look will re-appear. Consider a generic `.includes('avatars')` or an explicit denylist array constant.

wallet.tsx: TIERS thresholds are hardcoded inline in the JSX (Silver=500 / Gold=2500 / Platinum=10000). This is duplicated from backend logic — extract to `src/constants/tiers.ts` so future ladder changes are one-touch.
